column1: This workbook contains a synthetic (randomly generated, not real patient) dataset built to illustrate an ED analytics workflow.
1. Raw_Data - 10,000 row patient-level dataset (the requested fields)
2. Doctor_Workload - patient volume & wait time by ED doctor, by department
3. Department_Workload - daily trend, admission rate, bed wait, LOS by specialisation
4. Demand_Forecast - next month (Aug 2026) forecast using linear trend + day-of-week seasonality
5. KPI_Dashboard - headline metrics for a healthcare / ED manager
- Arrival volumes follow realistic day-of-week (busier Mon/weekends) and hourly (evening peak) patterns.
- Waiting times are lognormal-distributed, with adjustments for department crowding and peak hours.
- Forecast = OLS linear trend on daily volume x day-of-week seasonal index (average ratio of actual/trend per weekday).
An 80% interval is shown using the historical residual standard deviation.
- All figures are illustrative. Replace Raw_Data with real extract data to make this workbook operational.
